notes.title: X Archetype Graphical and Audio patch
notes.content: Hey Space Cowboys! I've updated the graphics and reworked fullscreen mode along with stretching and now theres no black bars or degredation of pixels either.  Sound changes include, chenged jump sound, changed Boss defeat sound, Heart sound, and Stage seletct music.
